caption: The drawing depicts a single dress, illustrated on a cream-colored background. The dress has a wide neckline, short puffed sleeves, and a fitted bodice, widening into a full skirt that reaches ankle-length. The main fabric of the dress is off-white, patterned with small, regularly spaced red floral motifs. Bands of ornate decoration encircle the neckline, waist, sleeves, and skirt; these bands feature an alternating pattern in earthy tones (reds and browns) with circular floral elements, and are edged with a bright blue trim. The blue trim is also present at the edges of the sleeves and the hem of the skirt. To the upper right of the main colored illustration, there is a simple, thin pencil sketch of the same dress, showing its structure without decorative details. The background remains plain and neutral throughout the image.
title: Child's Dress
